mapper.select: SELECT group_id, moim_account_id, user_id, invite_code, group_name, group_count, created_at, custom_rule, challenge_type, content, future_deposit_ratio_rule, duration_days, min_count, round_cycle_days, base_deposit_amount, group_status, updated_at FROM `groups` WHERE group_id = #{groupId}

SELECT group_user_id, group_id, user_id, group_user_status, approved_at, current_deposit_amount, streak_count, created_at, updated_at FROM group_users WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.account_id, a.user_id, a.kb_account_id, a.account_status, a.account_name, kb.account_number, kb.bank_name, kb.name AS owner_name, a.created_at, a.synced_at, a.updated_at FROM accounts a INNER JOIN kb_accounts kb ON kb.kb_account_id = a.kb_account_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND a.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ma.moim_account_id, ma.user_id, ma.kb_account_id, ma.account_status, ma.account_name, kb.account_number, kb.bank_name, kb.name AS owner_name, ma.created_at, ma.synced_at, ma.updated_at FROM moim_accounts ma INNER JOIN kb_accounts kb ON kb.kb_account_id = ma.kb_account_id WHERE ma.moim_account_id = #{moimAccountId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_accounts WHERE kb_account_id = #{kbAccountId} AND account_type = 'DEPOSIT'
mapper.update: UPDATE group_users SET current_deposit_amount = current_deposit_amount + #{amount} WHERE group_user_id = #{groupUserId}
UPDATE group_users SET group_user_status = #{status} WHERE group_user_id = #{groupUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT account_transaction_id, kb_account_id, group_user_id, round_id, transaction_type, transaction_category, amount, balance_after, idempotency_key, description, another_account_number, another_bank_name, another_name, created_at FROM account_transactions WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT gu.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, g.base_deposit_amount AS required_amount, gu.current_deposit_amount, gu.group_user_status FROM group_users gu JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = gu.group_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gu.user_id WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY gu.created_at ASC
